from pathlib import Path

previous = json.loads(Path('"'"'docs/_measurements/mouth_slow_drift.json'"'"').read_text())
rows = [dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in line.split()) for run in previous['"'"'runs'"'"'] for line in run['"'"'stdout'"'"']]
held, = [float(r['"'"'held'"'"']) for r in rows if r['"'"'grid'"'"']=='"'"'e24_c6'"'"' and r['"'"'radius'"'"']=='"'"'1'"'"' and r.get('"'"'d'"'"')=='"'"'8'"'"']
for cells in (4, 6, 8, 12):
    if cells in (4,6):
        grid = f'"'"'e24_c{cells}'"'"'
        lab, = [float(r['"'"'lab'"'"']) for r in rows if r['"'"'grid'"'"']==grid and r['"'"'radius'"'"']=='"'"'1'"'"' and '"'"'lab'"'"' in r]
        halo, = [float(r['"'"'layer_halo'"'"']) for r in rows if r['"'"'grid'"'"']==grid and r['"'"'radius'"'"']=='"'"'1'"'"' and '"'"'layer_halo'"'"' in r]
        print(f'"'"'cells={cells} rim_gap={abs(lab-halo):.12g}'"'"')
    else:
        path = Path(f'"'"'_scratch/s11c/mouth_drift_refine_e24_c{cells}_01'"'"')
        receipt = json.loads((path/'"'"'outcome.json'"'"').read_text())
        if receipt['"'"'exitCode'"'"']!=0 or not receipt['"'"'limitsVerified'"'"']:
            raise ValueError('"'"'Unsuccessful refinement'"'"')
        field = dict(w.split('"'"'='"'"') for w in (path/'"'"'stdout'"'"').read_text().split())
        lab, whole, halo = (float(field[k]) for k in ('"'"'lab'"'"','"'"'whole_layer'"'"','"'"'layer_halo'"'"'))
        print(f'"'"'cells={cells} rim_gap={abs(lab-halo):.12g} whole_gap={abs(lab-whole):.12g} '"'"'
              f'"'"'whole_gap_fraction_of_boundary={abs((lab-whole)/lab):.12g} '"'"'
              f'"'"'held_extent24_cells6_d8={held:.12g} speed=0.01 '"'"'
              f'"'"'boundary_magnitude_ppm_of_held={1e4*abs(lab)/held:.12g} '"'"'
              f'"'"'whole_magnitude_ppm_of_held={1e4*abs(whole)/held:.12g}'"'"')
'
